metadata.audit_scope: Complete codebase audit of ModelPortfolios page and subcomponents

files.file: Main page component for Model Portfolios page. Real-time AUA tracking and portfolio performance analysis with three tabs: Growth (donut chart, metrics, distribution), Performance (benchmark comparisons), and Peers (peer universe comparison).

Peers Tab component displaying quartile-based peer performance comparison with visual arrows showing model and benchmark positions relative to Morningstar peer universe. Includes annualized Since Inception returns calculation and interactive model selector.

types.type: Represents a single model portfolio with current metrics. Key fields: modelName (string), currentAUM (number), accountCount (number), metrics (MetricsPeriod[] - quarterly metrics)
Single data point in AUM time series. Key fields: period (string - date), aum (number), account_count (optional number)

Complete peer performance dataset. Key fields: generated_at (string), data_as_of (string), periods (string[] - list of period names), models (Record<string, ModelPeerData>)
Props for PeersTab component. Key fields: data (PeerPerformanceData | null), loading (optional boolean)

page_structure.tab: Default tab displaying Portfolio Analytics panel. Contains: (1) Left partition - Donut chart with AUA breakdown by model, interactive model legend, AUM Growth Metrics showing quarterly changes; (2) Right partition - Account Distribution bell curve chart showing fund distribution across models; (3) Non-Model AUA roll-forward note explaining data freshness

Performance comparison tab (content not fully read but referenced components include BenchmarkHeatmap and ReturnVolatilityScatter). Lazy loads benchmark data when tab becomes active. Displays model vs index/ETF benchmark returns with toggle for gross/net and index/ETF selection

Peer universe comparison tab. Displays PeersTab component showing quartile-based peer performance with model and benchmark position arrows, model selector buttons, and period-specific charts. Lazy loads peer performance data when tab becomes active

transformation.name: Annualize Since Inception Returns
transformation.description: Converts cumulative Since Inception returns to annualized returns using formula: (1 + cumulative_return) ^ (365/actual_days) - 1. Required because Excel data contains cumulative SI returns but display shows annualized to match lambda logic.
transformation.function: annualizeSinceInceptionReturn(cumulativeReturn: number | null, dataAsOf: string): number | null

transformation.name: Transform Peer Data
transformation.description: Applies annualization logic to entire peer performance dataset, transforming 'Since Inception' percentiles and model/benchmark values while preserving other periods as-is (cumulative)

transformation.name: Get Non-Model AUM for Date
transformation.description: Roll-forward lookup for Non-Model AUM data. Uses most recent known value for any date that doesn't have explicit data, since Non-Model data is updated sporadically
transformation.function: getNonModelAumForDate(timeSeries: Array<{ period: string; non_model_aum: number }> | undefined, targetDate: string): number

transformation.name: Get Last Actual Data Date
transformation.description: Finds the last date where enterprise data actually changed (not rolled forward), returns date string of last actual data point
transformation.function: getLastActualDataDate(timeSeries: Array<{ period: string; enterprise_total: number }> | undefined): string | null

transformation.name: Get Enterprise Total for Date
transformation.description: Roll-forward lookup for Enterprise Total (49 Financial total AUM). Returns enterprise_total for most recent date <= targetDate. Used for quarterly lookbacks to include non-model AUA in historical comparisons
transformation.function: getEnterpriseTotalForDate(timeSeries: Array<{ period: string; enterprise_total: number }> | undefined, targetDate: string): number | null

transformation.name: Sort By Model Order
transformation.description: Sorts model portfolios by canonical order (UST, ST, INT, LTC, LTA, optionally Non-Model). Used for consistent ordering in charts, legends, and tooltips
transformation.function: sortByModelOrder<T extends { modelName: string }>(portfolios: T[], includeNonModel: boolean = false): T[]

issues.issue: Redirect to login on 401 Unauthorized disabled - was causing infinite redirect loop for Model Portfolios page. Currently logs error but does not redirect

lifecycle_and_state.state_management: Uses React Query (TanStack Query) for all data fetching. No useEffect + useState patterns - all data management through useQuery hooks with proper loading/error states and lazy loading for performance and peers tabs
lifecycle_and_state.ui_state: - selectedDonutIndex: number | null - Track which model is selected in donut chart (null = show total) - periodView: 'monthly' | 'quarterly' - Toggle for time period granularity - trendMetricType: 'value' | 'count' - Toggle between AUM value and account count display - benchmarkReturnType: 'gross' | 'net' - Toggle for benchmark return type - benchmarkType: 'index' | 'etf' - Toggle between index and ETF benchmarks - activeTab: 'growth' | 'performance' | 'peers' - Current tab selection (managed by useTabNavigation hook) - selectedModel: 'UST' | 'ST' | 'INT' | 'LTC' | 'LTA' - Selected model in Peers tab (default 'LTC')
lifecycle_and_state.data_flow: 1. Page mounts -> useQuery hooks trigger for aum-metrics, aum-timeseries, account-distribution, non-model-assets (all enabled by default) 2. When user clicks 'performance' tab -> model-portfolio-benchmarks and etf-benchmark-returns queries enable 3. When user clicks 'peers' tab -> peer-performance query enables 4. Data arrives -> useMemo transforms/aggregates data 5. Components render with live data, no polling or refetching unless explicitly configured

known_limitations.limitation: Non-Model AUA data is rolled forward from last known value - may not reflect current actual state if updates are infrequent
API responses are accessed via portal-proxy Lambda which may have cached responses from CloudFront edge
Performance tab lazy loads data only when active - initial page load is fast but Performance tab has slight delay on first view
